verdict.rationale: Alma's O-1A founders page says its flat-rate pricing includes "no separate billing for RFE responses," which documents that RFE response work is part of the service. It also describes structuring cases to prevent ownership-control RFEs. The evidence is a single pricing-terms mention with no description of how responses are handled, and NOIDs are never mentioned. Missing for 10: any NOID coverage, documentation of the RFE response process (scope, timelines, attorney involvement), RFE-specific outcome data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings

citations.quote: Pricing is transparent and flat-rate, with no billable hours, no hidden costs, and no separate billing for RFE responses.
Proper entity structuring from the outset prevents Requests for Evidence (RFEs) challenging ownership control.
